title: Word Formation: Living in a Big City (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1-1.8), przeksztalcajac wyraz podany w ramce w taka forme, ktora logicznie i gramatycznie pasuje do kontekstu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych wyrazow. Dwa wyrazy zostaly podane dodatkowo i nie pasuja do zadnej luki.
tasks.text: Millions of people around the world choose to live in large cities, attracted by the opportunities they offer. 1.1. _________, city life also has its disadvantages. One of the greatest advantages is 1.2. _________: shops, hospitals and schools are usually within easy reach. During rush hour, however, buses and trains can become extremely 1.3. _________, and platforms are packed with commuters. Busy main roads are also very 1.4. _________, especially at night when traffic never seems to stop. On the positive side, cities offer a huge variety of 1.5. _________, from theatres and museums to concerts and sporting events. Long-term 1.6. _________ often say they could never go back to living in the countryside. 1.7. _________, many newcomers adapt to the fast pace within just a few weeks. The biggest concern for most city dwellers remains air 1.8. _________, which can damage people's health over time.
